title: Kalyan Inampudi
description: The journal of Kalyan Inampudi, UPSC mentor and edutainer from Hyderabad: quotes, books, press, talks and notes.
nameNote: A note on the name: iasips.in is simply a name that is easy to remember. This journal has no connection with the IAS, the IPS or the All India Services, or with anyone who serves in them, and I hold the services in the highest respect.

intro: I’m Kalyan Inampudi, Chief Mentor at La Excellence IAS in Hyderabad, where I teach Essay and Ethics. This is where I share what my curiosity finds each day.
